_meta.purpose: Maps assessment context factors to persona-specific prompt variations, scenario filtering, and report tone. Used by the ReasonLens assessment engine to tailor the experience to each respondent's context.

persona_mappings.label: School-Based Instructional Coach
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios are set in school contexts with realistic staff dynamics — including resistant teachers, time pressure, and accountability environments.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Professional, practical, and coaching-aware. Use language coaches themselves use. Frame gaps as practice opportunities, not deficiencies.

context_hints.coaching_scope: School-wide coaches face culture and leadership challenges. Department coaches can use subject-specific contexts. Individual coaching brings relational nuance.
context_hints.tech_expertise: Higher tech expertise coaches may anchor too strongly in tool knowledge — nuisance responses can exploit this.

persona_mappings.label: Higher Education Learning Technologist / Academic Developer
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios use HE CPD, curriculum design, and learning technology contexts. Reference academic autonomy, department-level adoption, and student digital capability.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Collegiate and research-literate. Acknowledge the hybrid nature of coaching in HE contexts. Avoid secondary school framing.

context_hints.coaching_scope: HE coaches often operate project-by-project rather than in sustained coaching relationships — scenarios should reflect this.
